behavior.task_enqueue: Call func_80007634(owner,message). Its first load reads message+0x10. Type 2 appends through owner+0x29C/+0x2A4 and sets owner+0x2B8; other types append through owner+0x2A0/+0x2A8. It clears message+0 and stores (message+8 & 3) at message+4. This helper does not mask interrupts and does not change owner+0x2AC/+0x2B0.
behavior.flags_and_probe: Read owner+0x2AC and +0x2B0 as 32-bit words. a3 bit 1 is set iff +0x2AC is zero; bit 0 iff +0x2B0 is zero. Call func_800077B8(owner,&stack_24,&stack_20,flags). If v0 equals flags, return. Helper internals beyond observed loads/stores/outputs are not inferred.
behavior.gate_and_start: Otherwise lbu D_80167858; nonzero returns. Zero calls func_8000769C(owner,stack_24,stack_20). The byte is initialized to zero by func_80006DF0, set in one func_8000769C path, and reset by func_80007324.
behavior.interrupts_and_aliasing: No osSetIntMask occurs in this target. Its duplicate global compare/store is unsynchronized in the observed body; do not claim general thread/interrupt atomicity. The owner is reloaded from stack after helpers rather than kept in a saved register.
